changes: Adds safe confirmed TV country-suffix aliases for USA/US, Australia/AU/AUS, United Kingdom/UK/GB, Canada/CA/CAN, and New Zealand/NZ/NZL.
Searches canonical and equivalent country-edition title forms through bounded Newznab compatibility queries and merges/deduplicates returned releases.
Makes local TV release identity validation accept the same exact country-suffix equivalence while rejecting conflicting editions and fuzzy/bare franchise aliases.
Expands the per-indexer search wall-clock allowance only enough to cover the canonical specialized request plus at most three bounded canonical/alias generic fallbacks.
regression_guards: Ordinary titles retain the prior canonical specialized-search fast path; aliases require persisted TV country identity to agree with an explicit canonical country suffix, and short codes must be uppercase.
Country-suffix aliases are bounded to USA/US, Australia/AU/AUS, United Kingdom/UK/GB, Canada/CA/CAN, and New Zealand/NZ/NZL; fuzzy/bare franchise aliases are not added.
Conflicting country editions remain rejected by the existing identity gate.
Base retry timing, Wanted policy, queue depth, release-feed behavior, and Continuous Automation scheduler semantics are unchanged.
v3.6.32 Automation target-integrity and no-downgrade protections remain intact.

v3.6.31 historical SAB probe quieting, v3.6.30 runtime-auth/no-op synchronization, v3.6.29 persistent HTTP/1.1 transport, and v3.6.28 Downloads visibility continuity are unchanged except for the required v3.6.33 adapter identity marker.
name: TV Edition Search Alias Compatibility
